title: GlyphStage — Kinetic Type Timeline Studio
description: Compose multi-scene kinetic typography sequences and export the finished loop as a real WebM video.
concept: GlyphStage is a tiny motion-graphics tool for text. Build a sequence of scenes — each with its own message, one of six animation presets, duration, color and background — arrange them on a scrubbable timeline, and preview the whole composition live on canvas. When it's ready, record the full loop straight out of the canvas as a downloadable WebM.
features: 6 kinetic-type animation presets: Typewriter, Wave, Shatter Assemble, Glitch Pop, Liquid Drip, Orbit In
Multi-scene timeline composer — add, duplicate, delete, reorder, and scrub scenes
Live style controls per scene: font family, size, letter spacing, text color, background theme
WebM video export via canvas.captureStream + MediaRecorder, plus single-frame PNG export
Named localStorage presets, autosave, and shareable URL-hash compositions

interaction.mouse: Drag the scrubber to scrub the timeline; click a scene row to edit it; hover buttons for tooltips.
interaction.click: Add/duplicate/delete/reorder scenes; Save/Load/Share/PNG/Export WebM buttons in the header.
interaction.touch: Scrubber and all controls are touch-friendly with pointer events; fullscreen button for immersive playback.
